messages:
alex: Heads-up — we're hitting public IP exhaustion in eu-west3 when autoscaling GPU node pools. Cloud NAT running out of external IPs. Need quota increase or alternative design.

maria: how many IPs left?

alex: ~6 free across the region. baseline uses ~20 per NAT gw per AZ, but batch GPU jobs spike and we hit port exhaustion. :grimacing: 

samir: which project/region exactly? can we avoid public IPs by using private egress + proxy or Shared VPC?

alex: Project: redwood-eu-prod, region eu-west3. Also we need a GPU quota bump for Dedicated pools — want to reserve more A100 capacity.

irene: I'll file the quota request. what numbers do we want?

alex: Requesting: External IPs -> increase to 100 for eu-west3. GPU quota -> 16 A100 equivalents (reserved for Dedicated). Also enabling Private Service Connect (PSC) / PrivateLink equivalent so model artifacts fetch over private endpoints.

samir: for Cloud NAT we can also raise ports-per-vm and use multiple NAT gateways per AZ with separate IP pools to reduce risk. But quota increase is the short term fix.

maria: can we add a caching layer for model artifacts so nodes don't all hit external egress at once? that's cheaper than lots of IPs.

alex: yes — GCS signed URLs + regional cache would help. but still need headroom for control-plane and third-party calls.

irene: Filed case C-123456789 with Google support. Added justification: production inference + batch training for canary rollouts. ETA from support: 48–72h.

maria: if this drags, I'll throttle GPU spot scale-ups on the autoscaler to avoid explosive consumption.

alex: infra changes we'll do: 1) subnet resize — current /22 per AZ is tight, proposing /20 per AZ 2) add separate NAT gateways with their own external IP pools 3) request external IP quota -> 100 4) request GPU quota -> +16 A100 5) enable PSC endpoints for artifact services 6) tweak Cloud NAT min/max ports.

samir: can you paste the commands you'll run for the NAT config?

alex: paste: 
```
# create reserved addresses (example)
gcloud compute addresses create nat-eu-west3-pool-1 --region=eu-west3 --addresses=34.XX.XX.XX,34.XX.XX.YY
# create router
gcloud compute routers create nat-router-eu3 --region=eu-west3 --network=prod-vpc
# create NAT config
gcloud compute routers nats create nat-config-1 --router nat-router-eu3 --region=eu-west3 --nat-external-ip-pool=nat-eu-west3-pool-1 --min-ports-per-vm=1024 --max-ports-per-vm=65536 --enable-logging
```
(placeholder IPs; will use reserved addresses returned by support)

irenE: oncall-bot: please confirm case update?

oncall-bot: case C-123456789 updated by irene. Status: Pending — Support requests billing justification and usage graphs.

irene: added cost/throughput graphs and a line-item justification for reserved capacity; sent to billing.

maria: once quota is in, what's the downtime for subnet resize?

alex: we'll do resize via new subnets and node migration — plan a rolling migration during low traffic window. No full downtime expected but there will be transient pod restarts. Target Wed 02:00 UTC. I'll open infra CR and schedule.

samir: also consider using Private Service Connect for model registry and artifact storage — reduces egress and simplifies firewall rules.

alex: agreed. I'll include PSC enablement in the CR and the quota ticket.

maria: ack. keep us posted.

samir: thx all :thumbsup:

alex: Opening infra PR and will link the support case + PR here when ready.
